q: Where should a rule like “never read .env” live in Claude Code?
options: In a deny permission rule or a hook, so it is enforced
explain: Instructions are requests; deny rules and hooks are enforcement.

q: What can a PreToolUse hook do?
options: See the exact tool call and allow it, block it with a reason, or ask the user
explain: Hooks enforce policy at fixed lifecycle points.

q: By default, when do Claude Code MCP tool definitions get deferred to tool search?
options: Only once they would exceed 10% of the context window
explain: Tool search is on by default; the 10% threshold applies only with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto (verified in the MCP docs, November 2026).
